states.name: INIT
states.description: Fresh instance before first scan. Outputs and retained alarm latches use initial_values.

states.name: VALID
states.description: Configuration is valid. High and low alarm hysteresis logic is processed.

states.name: ERROR_BAD_RANGE
states.description: loLevel >= hiLevel. error is TRUE, status is 16#8001, and alarm outputs are preserved.

states.name: ERROR_BAD_WINDOW
states.description: After badRange is excluded, hystWindow >= hiLevel - loLevel. error is TRUE, status is 16#8002, and alarm outputs are preserved.

transitions.condition: loLevel < hiLevel AND hystWindow >= hiLevel - loLevel
loLevel < hiLevel AND hystWindow < hiLevel - loLevel

high.condition: VALID AND hiLevel - hystWindow <= Value AND Value <= hiLevel

low.condition: VALID AND loLevel <= Value AND Value <= loLevel + hystWindow

timer_plan.notes: No timers are required. Hysteresis is implemented through retained alarm state, not time delays. No PT values and no timer reset conditions apply.

safety: Evaluate configuration validity before updating any alarm output.
Check badRange, loLevel >= hiLevel, before badWindow, hystWindow >= hiLevel - loLevel.
On badRange, set error := TRUE, status := 16#8001, preserve hiAlarm and loAlarm, and return early.
On badWindow after excluding badRange, set error := TRUE, status := 16#8002, preserve hiAlarm and loAlarm, and return early.
On valid configuration, clear error := FALSE and status := 0 before processing alarm hysteresis.
Use strict comparisons for alarm trigger and release; equality with a trigger or release threshold retains the previous alarm state.
No alarm update may occur during an invalid-configuration scan.
operational: High alarm sets TRUE when valid and Value > hiLevel.
High alarm sets FALSE when valid and Value < hiLevel - hystWindow.
High alarm retains its previous value when valid and hiLevel - hystWindow <= Value <= hiLevel.
Low alarm sets TRUE when valid and Value < loLevel.
Low alarm sets FALSE when valid and Value > loLevel + hystWindow.
Low alarm retains its previous value when valid and loLevel <= Value <= loLevel + hystWindow.
High and low alarm latches are updated independently.
